items.name: Finsupp.supported_iInter
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {ι : Type u_4} (s : ι → Set α) : Finsupp.supported M R (⋂ i, s i) = ⨅ i, Finsupp.supported M R (s i)

items.name: Finsupp.supported_inter
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (s t : Set α) : Finsupp.supported M R (s ∩ t) = Finsupp.supported M R s ⊓ Finsupp.supported M R t

items.name: Finsupp.lmapDomain_supported
items.type: {α : Type u_1} (M : Type u_2) (R : Type u_3) [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {α' : Type u_4} (f : α → α') (s : Set α) : Submodule.map (Finsupp.lmapDomain M R f) (Finsupp.supported M R s) = Finsupp.supported M R (f '' s)

items.name: Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single
items.type: {α : Type u_1} (R : Type u_3) [Semiring R] (s : Set α) : Finsupp.supported R R s = Submodule.span R ((fun i => fun₀ | i => 1) '' s)
